description: I'm excited to be a candidate for Indiana House District 29 and look forward to hearing from my neighbors, friends, and fellow constituents. If you have any questions or comments about issues facing the state or want to get involved in our campaign, please contact me. You can reach me by phone or email. I also invite you to follow me on my social media accounts to stay up to date with my campaign for IN 29. Let's work together for Noblesville!
